D: Teenagers at a psychiatric hospital who share the same nightmares team up with Nancy Thompson to fight back inside their dreams.
P: Serve the toasties when Kristen stays up late building her model house in the opening.
S: Lights-out tomato soup and cheese toasties
roasted tomato and garlic blitzed with stock, cheddar sandwiches toasted golden for dunking

Heat the oven to 200C. Toss 1kg halved tomatoes, the onion and garlic with 2 tbsp olive oil in a roasting tin. Roast until soft and catching at the edges. Blend with 500ml vegetable stock, the sugar and salt, then simmer in a pot. Butter the outsides of 8 slices of bread and fill 4 sandwiches with 200g grated cheddar. Toast in a frying pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden and melted, in batches. Cut into fingers and serve with the soup in cups.
red and green, just like the jumper he never takes off

Thread a cherry tomato, a basil leaf, a bocconcini and an olive onto each skewer, repeating so the red and green alternate. Lay on a platter, drizzle with the olive oil and balsamic glaze and sprinkle with salt.
M: beef mince ovals browned and simmered in onion and mushroom gravy, Hypnocil on the side

Mix 600g beef mince with the breadcrumbs, egg, diced onion, half the salt and the pepper, and shape into 4 thick ovals. Brown the patties in the oil for 4 minutes a side and set aside. Fry the sliced onion and mushrooms in the same pan until golden. Stir in the flour and tomato paste, add 500ml beef stock a little at a time, then return the patties and simmer covered. Meanwhile boil the potatoes until tender. Drain and mash the potatoes with the butter, milk and the rest of the salt, and cook the peas. Serve the patties and gravy over the mash with the peas.
W: golden syrup, ginger, cinnamon and clove dough, cut into little houses, baked crisp

Beat the butter and brown sugar until pale, then beat in the golden syrup and egg yolk. Sift in the flour, bicarb, ginger, cinnamon and cloves and mix to a soft dough. Wrap and chill. Heat the oven to 180C. Roll the dough 4mm thick between sheets of baking paper and cut into house shapes with a knife and a card template. Bake until firm at the edges. Cool on a rack. Beat the icing sugar with the egg white and lemon juice until stiff, then pipe on roof lines, windows and a front door.
K: strong black coffee, whatever it takes to keep your eyes open

Stir 100g coarse ground coffee into 800ml cold water, cover and refrigerate overnight. Strain through a paper filter. Stir the sugar into 60ml hot water until dissolved, add the vanilla and cool. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, pour in the cold brew and syrup and finish with a splash of cold milk.
